<!--
  The general application CV — the one to send where no vacancy-specific CV has been
  written. Built exactly like Bukin-cv-JRC-tax-2026.qmd, of which it is the generic
  sibling.

  It is cv-full.qmd with one change: the About paragraph is the profile tagged
  `in: [general]` in ../_cv.yml, which joins the website's framing to the specifics of
  the JRC-tax-2026 profile. Every other section is the full CV, entry for entry, so a
  correction to the record lands here as well. Like its siblings it states no fact
  about the person.

  Its header asks for private=true, so unlike the two public CVs it also carries the
  contact details the website does not publish — location, nationality, birth, phone,
  email — read from ../_cv-private.yml, which is gitignored. Without that file the line
  is simply left out.

  The file is named for the PDF it becomes, Bukin-cv-general.pdf: that PDF goes out as
  an attachment as it is, so the source carries the name the attachment should.

  It is built by every render, like its siblings, and lands in ../_site/cv/. It is not
  published: the deploy step in ../.github/workflows/publish.yml deletes every PDF in
  _site/cv/ except cv-full.pdf and cv-short.pdf before uploading the site.
-->
